title: Prepositions of Place
objectives: Understand and use prepositions of place.
Avoid common mistakes from Portuguese transfer.
canDo: I can use in, on, at, under, behind, in front of for location.

warmUp.title: Warm-up
warmUp.prompt: Think about when you need "prepositions of place" in real life.
reflectionQuestions: Can you give one example of Prepositions of Place?

explanation:
In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address

The station is at the end of the street.

Behind, in front of, between, opposite

(Para falantes de português: compare com o equivalente em português e note diferenças de estrutura.)

grammar.title: Prepositions of Place
grammar.rule: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address

examples.sentence: The garden is behind the house.
The car is in front of the building.
The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.

reading.title: Prepositions of Place — Reading
reading.text: Every day, people use prepositions of place in conversation. The garden is behind the house. The car is in front of the building. The bank is between the café and the pharmacy. This helps learners speak more naturally at A1 level.
